ambiguous_delivery_protocol.commit_detection_rule: If fresh LATEST contains this exact deterministic effect key under the frozen authority tuple, classify the effect as committed.
ambiguous_delivery_protocol.replay_rule: If committed effect key is present, classify replay as duplicate_effect_key and perform zero second logical advance; never issue a second same-run pointer write.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: lightweight durable state/evidence transport only; no hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, external model/API credit, or manual user execution is on the tested path
mechanism_assessment.tested_limit: Single role-local ambiguous-delivery case with one candidate, one CAS-guarded pointer advance, one deterministic effect key, and replay suppression by fresh-read key detection. Multi-candidate arbitration, concurrent-writer fairness, and transport-level lost-before-server vs lost-after-server distinction remain open.
